title: Studio flow node inspector: on a read-only package every control is disabled with no reason on hover, keyboard focus or to assistive tech
body:
domain:devx#1 · os-warren · session_01JQwxbWJDYbbtH6dhJNoboN

立卡门: ① 产品缺陷（用户可见体验缺陷），具名落点 + 复现（reach: 界面，Studio 打开只读包的流程节点，实测两次）
业务理由: 打开只读包（例如已安装的 showcase）流程的管理员，点中一个节点后右侧属性栏全部灰掉，鼠标悬停、键盘 Tab、读屏都得不到任何原因，只能猜为什么不能改。字段栏（objectui#12303）和校验规则编辑器（objectui#12691）已经修过同一类问题，流程节点栏没跟上；ux-conventions.disabled-control-reason 因此判失败。
动手的读者: domain:ui 席，`ui/packages/app-shell/src/views/metadata-admin/inspectors/FlowNodeInspector.tsx`：只读时控件现为 `disabled={readOnly}`（约 L711、736、741、747、816、862），套上字段栏已有的可聚焦、带 aria-describedby 的只读原因包装（StudioDesignSurface.tsx 约 L9380–9410 的做法）。
查重: `FlowNodeInspector disabled reason` 5 命中、`flow inspector read-only disabled tooltip` 11（均含已关）；只有运行记录和已关的建议汇总 #27356/#27521，没有本缺陷的卡。

QA-source: #28981 · ux-conventions.disabled-control-reason · A0, A1, A2

## What happens
On a read-only package, the Studio flow canvas shows a "Read-only" badge and Publish carries its reason. But select a node and every control of the node inspector is disabled with no reason anywhere:
- ID, Label, Node Type, Function, Inputs (and their Remove/CEL toggles), Add entry, Output variable, Timeout, Remove node;
- no tooltip on hover and no adjacent text;
- Tab never reaches the controls or a described ancestor; `aria-describedby` is null and `title` is empty.

Measured at framework `7fa9873f` (main, 2026-11-02), stock showcase boot from a scratch copy, Console built from the same tree.

## Reproduction
1. Boot the showcase; form sign-in as admin.
2. Open `/_console/studio/com.example.showcase/automations?surface=flow:showcase_task_completed`.
3. Click the canvas node "Compose Summary".
4. Hover the "Remove node" button for 1 s; Tab from the top of the page; read `aria-describedby` and `title` on "Remove node" and the Label input.
5. **Expected:** the read-only reason on hover, on keyboard focus and as an accessible description, as the field rail and the validation editor give it.
6. **Actual:** none of the three. Reproduced on two fresh loads.
